info.name: OkoaFloat Backend API
info.description: Import this collection, set baseUrl and credentials, then run Login followed by Verify Login OTP. Enter each OTP in the otp collection variable. Successful verification stores accessToken and refreshToken. Additional Registered API Routes includes the remaining registered backend routes; replace sample path IDs and provide endpoint-specific query/body fields before testing.

exec: pm.test('OTP verification issues an access token', () => pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

item.name: Additional Registered API Routes
item.description: Routes registered by the running Flask application that were not already represented in this collection.
